theme.title: LeBron's MVP leap
theme.subtitle: Cleveland Cavaliers, 2008–09
theme.recap: LeBron won his first MVP as Cleveland posted the NBA's best record, only for Dwight Howard's Magic to derail the championship dream.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did LeBron's 2008–09 Cavaliers win?
questions.note: 66 victories, the best record in the NBA that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They finished the regular season with 66 wins and 16 losses

funFacts.text: LeBron won his first MVP award and finished runner-up in Defensive Player of the Year voting.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: LeBron James won his first MVP Award and finished second in Defensive Player of the Year voting.

funFacts.text: Mike Brown earned Coach of the Year honors as Cleveland raced to the East's top seed.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Mike Brown was named NBA Coach of the Year for the 2008–2009 season.

funFacts.text: Cleveland ended its playoff run after sweeping both Detroit and Atlanta, before Orlando stopped them in the conference finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Cavaliers swept the Detroit Pistons in the First Round in four games, swept the Atlanta Hawks in the Semifinals in four games

questions.prompt: How many home games did the Cavaliers win in their dominant 2008–09 season?
questions.context: Cleveland at Quicken Loans Arena · 41 home games
questions.note: 39 home wins against just two losses.

funFacts.text: Cleveland also won 27 road games that season, giving the team balance away from its home arena.
The Lakers handed Cleveland a rare home loss during their February visit.
The Cavaliers lost their final regular-season home game in overtime against Philadelphia.

questions.prompt: How many assists per game did LeBron average in his first MVP season?
questions.note: 7.2 assists per game while running Cleveland's attack.

funFacts.text: LeBron also averaged 28.4 points and 7.6 rebounds in the regular season.
In November, LeBron became the youngest player in league history to reach 11,000 career points.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On November 18, LeBron James became the youngest player to reach 11,000 career points

funFacts.text: LeBron overtook Mark Price as Cleveland's all-time steals leader that December.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: LeBron James passed Mark Price to become the Cavaliers' all-time steals leader

questions.prompt: How many points per game did Mo Williams average in his first Cavaliers season?
questions.note: 17.8 points per game as LeBron's new backcourt partner.

funFacts.text: Williams made 43.6% of his three-pointers that season, while shooting 91.2% at the line.
Cleveland acquired Williams from Milwaukee in a three-team trade during the offseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: To Milwaukee Bucks----Damon Jones----To Oklahoma City Thunder----Joe Smith | To Cleveland Cavaliers----Mo Williams

funFacts.text: Williams posted a season-high 44 points against Phoenix in February.

questions.prompt: How many points did LeBron score in Game 1 of the 2009 Eastern finals?
questions.context: Cleveland vs Orlando · Eastern Conference finals · Game 1
questions.note: 49 points, but Orlando won the opener by one.

funFacts.text: Cleveland swept both Detroit and Atlanta before the Eastern Conference finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Cavaliers swept the Detroit Pistons in the First Round in four games, swept the Atlanta Hawks in the Semifinals in four games

funFacts.text: LeBron averaged a remarkable 35.3 points during Cleveland's entire playoff run.
The Magic eventually reached the NBA Finals but lost to Kobe Bryant's Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Magic would go on to lose to the Los Angeles Lakers in the NBA Finals in five games.
